about: The shared words and small rules of "Grade this better" (docs/STUDY-FROM-TEXT-DESIGN.md section 15, JARVIS-API section 113), word for word, plus sample replies of the frozen shapes. Written by tools/gen_quiz_cloud_cases.py: both apps' tests read this file.

failures.cloud_failed: The cloud service could not mark the quiz. Your marks were not changed.
failures.cloud_timeout: The cloud service took too long to answer. Your marks were not changed.
failures.cloud_unreadable: The service answered, but not with one mark for each question, so Jarvis used none of it. Your marks were not changed.
failures.quiz_changed: The quiz changed after the card was shown (an answer was added or it went private), so nothing was sent. Start again to see a new card.
failures.quiz_closed: The quiz was closed before anything was sent. Nothing was sent.
failures.service_missing: This PC's Jarvis does not have the cloud services set up (jarvis_chatbot_api.py) - run apply-patches.ps1 on the PC. Nothing was sent.

after_crisis.message: This quiz stays on this PC.

already_started.message: It is already being sent and can no longer be cancelled.

bad_request.message: That request was not understood. Nothing was sent.

bad_service.message: There is no such service. Leave it empty and Jarvis picks the cheapest one that is set up.

card_unavailable.message: Jarvis could not raise the approval card. Nothing was sent.

no_service.message: No cloud service is set up for this yet. A service needs a saved key AND a monthly money limit, both set on this PC. {how}

not_text_quiz.message: Only a quiz on a text can be marked by a cloud service, not Spanish practice. Its marks stay on this PC.

nothing_answered.message: Answer at least one question first.

outside_source_refused.message: This quiz was made from text Jarvis did not write or receive from you, other than YouTube captions, so it stays on this PC.

outside_text_turn.message: Jarvis has just read outside text or private things in this conversation, so it will not send a quiz anywhere now. Start from the Quiz page.

private_material.message: This quiz touches money, health, a password, an account or ID number, or another private thing, so it stays on this PC.

private_unchecked.message: Jarvis could not check whether this quiz has private things in it, so it stays on this PC.

quiz_not_found.message: That quiz is not open any more (it may have ended or timed out).

quiz_private.message: This quiz is marked private, so it stays on this PC.

request_not_found.message: That grading request is not open any more. Start a new one.

request_waiting.message: A grading card is already waiting. Answer it first.

service_not_ready.message: That service cannot be used yet. {why}

tier_not_ask.message: This needs your yes every time, but the settings file says otherwise, so it is switched off.

too_big.message: This quiz is too big to send in one go. Its marks stay on this PC.

request.message: You said no, so nothing was sent.

body.intro: Send this quiz to a cloud AI service that marks it more carefully than the model on this PC. It asks with a card first, every time, and the card lists exactly what would leave this PC.
body.leaves: This sends your questions, your answers and the passages to an outside company. It costs a little money and is kept under that company's own terms. Nothing private is ever sent.
